title: DecisionPrinciples
description: Machine-readable do-list: the 10 normative rules every contributor and every agent follows. Migrated from docs/CONSTITUTION.md §Decision principles — Do during the 2026-05-15 CONSTITUTION strike per root-hub-pointers.json _retired_constitutional_authority migration map.

_meta.purpose: Canonical do-list for contributor and agent behavior. Each principle binds; failures to apply produce mechanical or cultural prevention rows in docs/MISTAKES-LEDGER.md.

principles.title: Cohesion over portfolio
principles.statement: Every architectural decision is judged by whether it preserves the single tenancy / identity / audit-chain / agent-runtime promise. Split-brain decisions that gain local convenience are rejected.

principles.title: Catalog-first authoring
principles.statement: Every change updates the right doc tier in the same PR. Code without doc-update is not 'done'.

enforcement.evidence: doc-catalog lane refuses PRs that change a canonical surface without updating dependents the catalog names

principles.title: Mechanical prevention over process
principles.statement: Recurring failures produce a CI lane, hook, validator, or schema check — not a checklist line.

enforced_by: docs/MISTAKES-LEDGER.md row contract: every MFL row REQUIRES a non-empty mechanical_prevention field; process-only fixes are rejected per docs/standards/prevention-doctrine.md §6
enforcement.evidence: MFL row template in docs/templates/mistakes-ledger-row-template.md enforces field at authoring time

principles.title: Dual audience for instructions
principles.statement: Every directive read by an agent is also readable to a human, and vice versa. No agent-only checklists; no human-only prose.

enforcement.evidence: PR review; no current programmatic check (gap candidate for oya-governance-dual-audience lane)

principles.title: Single canonical tree
principles.statement: All authority lives under docs/. Files outside the tree are non-authoritative discovery surfaces or working drafts.

enforcement.evidence: Planned authoritative-tracked lane will verify every doc cited as authoritative in docs/AGENTS.md is repo-tracked; current control is PR review.

principles.title: Bounded scope per doc
principles.statement: Every canonical doc has a single class, a single owner, a hard length cap, and an explicit 'Does NOT cover' clause. Drift-by-overlap is a structural failure, not a hope.

enforcement.evidence: doc-style lane enforces length cap + frontmatter shape per doc_class

principles.title: Forward-reference, never invent
principles.statement: A cross-link to a doc that does not yet exist uses the forward-reference sentinel; it does not silently link to nothing.

enforcement.evidence: convention: <!-- forward-reference: wave-N --> sentinel; no current programmatic resolution check (gap candidate for oya-governance-forward-reference-resolution lane)

principles.title: Audit-chain emission on every cross-axis flow
principles.statement: Cross-pillar data movement is audited; auditless cross-flow is a defect, not an optimization.

enforcement.evidence: audit-chain emission verification deferred until M02-P04-audit-chain ships the substrate µservice; currently relies on per-PR review

principles.title: Bench-and-stress before claiming performance
principles.statement: Benchmark + at least two stress scenarios precede any 'performance is acceptable' claim.

enforcement.evidence: No mechanical enforcement today. The 4 stub crates that claimed to enforce this (check-statelessness, -shardability, -perf-budget, -benchmark) were deleted 2026-05-15 — 6-line doc-stubs claiming 'Accepted' status are worse than no crate (per audit). PRs cite performance claims; review is the only check until real lane crates ship under M02 substrate. Re-introduction requires a real implementation, not a doc-stub.

principles.title: Cancel cleanly
principles.statement: Long-running loops re-walk the Done-Definition checklist before ending; loops do not exit silently.

enforcement.evidence: Done-Definition checklist in docs/AGENTS.md; no programmatic cancel-cleanly gate

enforcement_modes.mechanical: A CI lane / hook / validator / fitness function refuses non-compliant changes at PR time or commit time. Programmatic, deterministic, replay-as-eval testable.
enforcement_modes.cultural: No programmatic check today. Compliance via PR review + Done-Definition checklist. Candidate for future mechanization.
enforcement_modes.mechanical-stub: A lane exists by name but the implementation is a placeholder (6-line doc stub). Claim of enforcement is honest only after the stub is replaced. Tracked as a gap.
enforcement_modes.deferred: Enforcement depends on infrastructure not yet shipped (e.g., M02-P04 audit-chain substrate). Will become mechanical once the substrate lands.

references: docs/MISTAKES-LEDGER.md — failure-mode row registry with mechanical_prevention field
